attributes.storage_note: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Keep the bottle tightly closed after each use. Avoid exposure to excessive heat and humidity. Do not freeze the product. Keep the pump nozzle clean to maintain hygiene. Store out of reach of children. For external use only. Use within 6–12 months after opening (or as indicated on the packaging).
